MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
The lecture continues Topic 8 and covers glass-strengthening techniques through heat treatment, chemical strengthening via ion exchange, and surface compressive-stress methods; applications span automotive, architecture, defense, and displays.
